title_en: First Branch of Tianjin Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Dong Hui, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao — kidnapping
ruling_gist_en: According to Article 25 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, a joint crime refers to an intentional crime committed jointly by two or more persons, and each joint offender must have the intent to commit a joint crime. The so-called intent of a joint crime means that each joint offender, through mutual communication of intent, knows that he or she is cooperating with others to jointly commit a crime, understands the nature of the joint criminal act and the harmful social consequences caused by that act, and desires or is indifferent to the occurrence of such consequences. If an actor does not understand the true criminal intent of others, is unaware of the nature of the criminal act committed by others, but participates in the crime committed by others due to being deceived or acting under his or her own mistaken understanding of the nature of the crime, then the actor cannot be found to have committed a joint crime with others. Instead, the actor should be correctly convicted and punished based on the actual circumstances of his or her own criminal conduct, in accordance with the principle of consistency of subjective and objective elements.

full_text_en:
First Branch of Tianjin People's Procuratorate v.

Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Dong Hui, Yan Yufeng,

Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, Liu Chao — kidnapping dispute

Ruling Summary

According to Article 25 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, a joint crime refers to an intentional crime committed by two or more persons jointly, and each joint offender must have the intent of joint crime. The so-called intent of joint crime means that each joint offender knows through communication of intent that he is cooperating with others to commit a crime, understands the nature of the joint criminal act and the socially harmful result caused by that act, and hopes for or acquiesces in the occurrence of that result. If an actor does not understand the true criminal intent of others, does not know the nature of the criminal act committed by others, but participates in the crime committed by others due to being deceived by others or out of his own mistaken understanding, and under a mistaken understanding of the nature of the crime, then it cannot be determined that the actor committed a joint crime with others. Instead, the actor should be correctly convicted and punished according to the actual circumstances of his crime, in accordance with the principle of unity of subjectivity and objectivity.

Procuratorial Authority: First Branch of Tianjin People's Procuratorate.

Defendant: Li Bin, also known as Da Bin, male, 25 years old, Han nationality, farmer, residing in Wangkou Town, Jinghai County, Tianjin. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 26, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Yuan Nanjing, also known as Yuan Jinqiang, male, 33 years old, Han nationality, farmer, residing in Zhaozhuang Town, Feng County, Jiangsu Province. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 23, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Hu Haizhen, also known as Da Zhen, male, 24 years old, Han nationality, farmer, residing in Liangwangzhuang Township, Jinghai County, Tianjin. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 26, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Dong Hui, also known as Xiao Hui, male, 24 years old, Han nationality, farmer, residing in Wangkou Town, Jinghai County, Tianjin. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 26, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Yan Yufeng, also known as Chou Zi, male, 20 years old, Han nationality, farmer, residing in Qiujiadian Town, Taishan District, Tai'an City, Shandong Province. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 25, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Liu Shaorong, male, 20 years old, Han nationality, unemployed, residing in Taishan District, Tai'an City, Shandong Province. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 25, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Liu Yu, male, 21 years old, Han nationality, student, residing in Taishan District, Tai'an City, Shandong Province. Detained on suspicion of kidnapping on March 25, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

Defendant: Liu Chao, male, 18 years old, Han nationality, unemployed, residing in Taishan District, Tai'an City, Shandong Province. Detained on April 11, 2006, and arrested on April 27, 2006.

The First Branch of Tianjin People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Dong Hui, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao for the crime of kidnapping, bringing the case before Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court.

The indictment alleged: In early March 2006, defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui conspired to kidnap the victim Shi Linqing to extort money. Yuan Nanjing, on the pretext of helping others collect a debt, recruited defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao to participate in the crime. At approximately 2:00 a.m. on March 9, 2006, Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao, carrying pre-prepared tools, drove to Shi Linqing's residence in Zhengzhuangzi Village, Wangkou Town, Jinghai County, Tianjin, and, impersonating public security officers, forcibly kidnapped Shi Linqing to a house in the mountainous area of Tai'an City, Shandong Province. According to pre-arranged division of labor, Dong Hui remained in Tianjin to monitor whether Shi Linqing's family reported the crime to the police, while Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao were responsible for guarding Shi Linqing. Subsequently, Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen extorted a ransom of RMB 800,000 from Shi Linqing's family, used the money to purchase gold, and then divided and squandered it. On March 10, 2006, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao learned that there was no debt relationship whatsoever between Shi Linqing and Li Bin et al, and after Shi Linqing agreed to give them RMB 100,000, they released Shi Linqing the following afternoon. Thereafter, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, and Liu Shaorong demanded RMB 60,000 from Shi Linqing, which they divided and squandered. In summary, the actions of Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Dong Hui, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao violated Articles 239 and 25 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Criminal Law"), and all constituted the crime of kidnapping. Liu Chao was under 18 years old at the time of the crime, so the provisions of Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law should apply for a lighter punishment. The prosecutorial authority requested that the above defendants be held criminally liable according to law.

All defendants admitted to the main criminal facts alleged by the prosecutorial authority.

Defendant Li Bin argued: The kidnapping was not proposed by himself.

Defendant Dong Hui and his defense counsel argued: Dong Hui did not specifically carry out the kidnapping act; he was an accomplice, had a good attitude in admitting guilt, and requested a lighter punishment.

Defendant Yan Yufeng argued: He did not participate in the conspiracy to commit the kidnapping crime beforehand; he had no intent to kidnap and did not constitute the crime of kidnapping.

Defendants Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, Liu Chao and their defense counsel all argued: They did not participate in the conspiracy to commit the kidnapping crime beforehand; they only thought they were helping collect debts, had no intent to kidnap, and did not extort the victim afterwards; therefore, they did not constitute the crime of kidnapping.

The facts found by Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court at first instance:

In early March 2006, defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui conspired to kidnap the victim Shi Linqing to extort money. Yuan Nanjing, on the pretext of helping others collect a debt, recruited defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao to participate in the crime. At approximately 2:00 a.m. on March 9, 2006, Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao, carrying pre-prepared tools, drove to Shi Linqing's residence in Zhengzhuangzi Village, Wangkou Town, Jinghai County, Tianjin, and, impersonating public security officers, forcibly kidnapped Shi Linqing to a house in the mountainous area of Tai'an City, Shandong Province. Li Bin and Yuan Nanjing assigned Dong Hui to remain in Tianjin to monitor whether Shi Linqing's family reported the crime to the police, and assigned Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao to guard Shi Linqing at the location. Subsequently, Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen extorted a ransom of RMB 800,000 from Shi Linqing's family in two installments, both times instructing Shi Linqing's family to deposit the money into credit card accounts opened in advance by Li Bin et al. Thereafter, Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen used the money to purchase large quantities of gold by card swiping in Qinhuangdao, Huludao, Tangshan, and other places, which they divided and squandered.

On March 10, 2006, defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao learned that there was no debt relationship whatsoever between the victim Shi Linqing and defendant Li Bin et al. After Shi Linqing agreed to give them RMB 100,000, they released Shi Linqing the following afternoon.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence: testimony of the victim Shi Linqing, confessions of each defendant, witness testimony, a price appraisal certificate, a case source statement and records of the arrest of each defendant issued by the public security organ, inspection and examination records, and related photographs. The evidence is sufficient for determination.

Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court held:

Defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui forcibly kidnapped another person for the purpose of extorting property; their actions constituted the crime of kidnapping and should be punished according to law. Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen played a primary role in the joint crime and were principals. Dong Hui played a secondary role in the joint crime and was an accomplice, so his punishment should be mitigated according to law.

Defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao did not participate in the conspiracy to commit the kidnapping crime; they were recruited by Yuan Nanjing and participated in the crime in this case for the purpose of helping others collect a debt, and specifically carried out the criminal act of illegally detaining and imprisoning another person. Their actions constituted the crime of unlawful detention and should also be punished according to law. The allegation by the prosecutorial authority that Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao extorted RMB 60,000 from the victim Shi Linqing lacked sufficient evidence and could not be established; the allegation that Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao committed the crime of kidnapping could not be established. Liu Chao was under 18 years old at the time of the crime, so his punishment should be lenient according to law.

Accordingly, Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 239, Paragraph 1, Article 238, Paragraphs 1 and 3, Article 25, Paragraph 1, Article 26, Paragraphs 1 and 4, Article 27, Article 17, Paragraphs 1 and 3, Article 57, Paragraph 1, and Article 64 of the Criminal Law, on October 9, 2006, rendered the following judgment:

1. Defendant Li Bin was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; Defendant Yuan Nanjing was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; Defendant Hu Haizhen was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000; Defendant Dong Hui was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to 8 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000; Defendant Yan Yufeng was convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 3 years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Shaorong was convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 2 years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Yu was convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 1 year's imprisonment; Defendant Liu Chao was convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 8 months' imprisonment.

2. The instrument of crime, one Santana automobile (license plate number Ji RC3457, vehicle identification number SVAF03343235549), was confiscated according to law.

3. Recovery of the illicit gains obtained by each defendant shall continue, and the amounts shall be returned to the victim Shi Linqing.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, the First Branch of Tianjin People's Procuratorate filed a protest with Tianjin High People's Court, arguing that the actions of the original trial defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao constituted the crime of kidnapping, that the first-instance characterization was erroneous, the punishment was disproportionately light, and should be corrected.

Yuan Nanjing, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to Tianjin High People's Court, arguing that he did not participate in the conspiracy to kidnap and that the original sentence was too heavy.

Upon second instance, Tianjin High People's Court held: The indictment alleged that the original trial defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, and Liu Shaorong, after releasing the victim Shi Linqing, extorted RMB 60,000 from Shi Linqing for division and squandering. The first-instance judgment did not establish this fact, which constitutes a finding of unclear facts. Accordingly, Tianjin High People's Court, in accordance with Article 189, Paragraph (3) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on December 20, 2006, rendered the following ruling:

1. The first-instance criminal judgment in this case rendered by Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court was set aside;

2. This case was remanded to Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court for retrial.

Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court, after legally forming a new collegial panel for retrial, confirmed the facts established in the original first instance. Additionally, the following was found: After the victim Shi Linqing was kidnapped to a house in the mountainous area of Tai'an City, Shandong Province, he was guarded by defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao. On March 11, 2006, during a conversation with Shi Linqing, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao learned that there was no debt relationship whatsoever between Shi Linqing and defendant Li Bin et al. Shi Linqing requested the above defendants to release him and promised to give them benefits. After discussion, the above defendants released Shi Linqing. Thereafter, Yan Yufeng, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Yu, together with Liu Chuan (separately handled), repeatedly called Shi Linqing to demand money. Fearing further retaliation, Shi Linqing deposited RMB 60,000 into an account designated by Yan Yufeng et al. Yan Yufeng, Liu Shaorong, Liu Yu, and Liu Chuan divided and squandered that money.

The focus of dispute in this case is: How should the actions of defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao be characterized?

Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court held:

Defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui forcibly kidnapped another person for the purpose of extorting property; their actions constituted the crime of kidnapping and should be punished according to law. Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen played a primary role in the joint crime and were principals. Dong Hui played a secondary role in the joint crime and was an accomplice, so his punishment should be mitigated according to law.

According to Article 25 of the Criminal Law, a joint crime refers to an intentional crime committed by two or more persons jointly, and each joint offender must have the intent of joint crime. The so-called intent of joint crime means that each joint offender knows through communication of intent that he is cooperating with others to commit a crime, understands the nature of the joint criminal act and the socially harmful result caused by that act, and hopes for or acquiesces in the occurrence of that result. If an actor does not understand the true criminal intent of others, does not know the nature of the criminal act committed by others, but participates in the crime committed by others due to being deceived by others or out of his own mistaken understanding, and under a mistaken understanding of the nature of the crime, then it cannot be determined that the actor committed a joint crime with others. Instead, the actor should be correctly convicted and punished according to the actual circumstances of his crime, in accordance with the principle of unity of subjectivity and objectivity. In this case, defendants Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao did not participate beforehand in the conspiracy between defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui to commit the kidnapping crime. Under the recruitment of Yuan Nanjing, they mistakenly believed they were helping others collect a debt and, based on that purpose, carried out the criminal act of illegally detaining and imprisoning another person. Therefore, the actions of Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao do not constitute joint kidnapping crime; instead, they should be convicted and punished for the crime of unlawful detention in accordance with Article 238, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law. After Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, and Liu Shaorong released the victim Shi Linqing, they, together with Liu Chuan, used coercive means to demand a huge sum of money from Shi Linqing, and their actions constituted the crime of extortion, which should be punished according to law.

In summary, the facts of the crimes committed by defendants Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, Dong Hui, Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao, as alleged by the prosecutorial authority, are clear and supported by sufficient evidence; the allegation that Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, Hu Haizhen, and Dong Hui committed the crime of kidnapping is correct and should be confirmed; the allegation that Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, Liu Shaorong, and Liu Chao committed the crime of kidnapping is improper. The actions of Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, and Liu Shaorong each constitute the crime of unlawful detention and the crime of extortion, and they should be subject to joinder of punishments according to law. The actions of Liu Chao constitute the crime of unlawful detention, which should also be punished according to law. Li Bin, Yuan Nanjing, and Hu Haizhen played a primary role in the joint crime and were principals, and should be punished separately according to the entirety of the crimes in which they each participated. Dong Hui played a secondary role in the joint crime and was an accomplice, so his punishment should be mitigated according to law. Yan Yufeng, Liu Yu, and Liu Shaorong each played a primary role in the joint crimes of unlawful detention and extortion and were principals, and should be punished separately according to the entirety of the crimes in which they participated. Liu Chao played a supporting role in the joint crime of unlawful detention and was an accomplice, and since he was under 18 years old at the time of the crime, he should be exempted from punishment according to law. Accordingly, Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 239, Paragraph 1, Article 238, Paragraphs 1 and 3, Article 274, Article 69, Article 25, Paragraph 1, Article 26, Paragraphs 1 and 4, Article 27, Article 17, Paragraphs 1 and 3, Article 57, Paragraph 1, Article 37, and Article 64 of the Criminal Law, on April 24, 2007, rendered the following judgment:

1. Defendant Li Bin was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; Defendant Yuan Nanjing was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; Defendant Hu Haizhen was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000 (to be paid within one month after the judgment takes effect); Defendant Dong Hui was convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to 8 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000 (to be paid within one month after the judgment takes effect); Defendant Yan Yufeng was convicted of extortion and sentenced to 4 years' imprisonment; convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 2 years' imprisonment; the combined sentence was 5 years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Shaorong was convicted of extortion and sentenced to 3 years' imprisonment; convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 1 year's imprisonment; the combined sentence was 3 years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Yu was convicted of extortion and sentenced to 3 years' imprisonment; convicted of unlawful detention and sentenced to 1 year's imprisonment; the combined sentence was 3 years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Chao was convicted of unlawful detention and exempted from criminal punishment.

2. The instrument of crime, one Santana automobile (license plate number Ji RC3457, vehicle identification number LSVAF03343235549), was confiscated according to law.

3. Recovery of the illicit gains obtained by each defendant shall continue, and the amounts shall be returned to the victim.

Yuan Nanjing and Liu Yu, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment rendered upon retrial by Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court, appealed to Tianjin High People's Court. During the second-instance proceedings, Yuan Nanjing and Liu Yu applied to withdraw their appeals.

Tianjin High People's Court held upon second instance:

The facts found in the first-instance judgment were clear, the evidence was reliable and sufficient, the conviction was accurate, the punishment was appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful. In accordance with Articles 239 and 244 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on June 19, 2007, the following ruling was rendered:

The applications by appellants Yuan Nanjing and Liu Yu to withdraw their appeals were permitted.

This ruling is final.
